meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为 NanoClaw 创建一个 macOS 菜单栏状态指示器(仅 macOS):带绿/红点的闪电图标,绿点表示运行中,红点表示已停止;点击可启动、停止、重启服务并查看日志。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加 macOS 菜单栏状态指示器,或说出 /add-macos-statusbar 时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态指示器
say.note: Claude 会检查系统并开始安装。

say.text: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 的运行状态
say.note: 该请求会创建状态栏图标。

howto.what_en: Adds a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw (macOS only): a bolt icon with a green/red dot showing running/stopped state; clicking it can start, stop, restart the service, and view logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw, or says /add-macos-statusbar.

say_en.text: Add the menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw
say_en.note: Checks the system and starts installation.

say_en.text: Show NanoClaw's status in the menu bar
say_en.note: This request creates the status bar icon.
